tools.name: check_sponsor
tools.description: Is this organisation on the UK Home Office Register of Licensed Sponsors? Returns the best match (null when nothing resembles the name), its routes, rating, town, Companies House number, live sponsored jobs on Tarve, and up to 5 alternative matches.

tools.name: search_sponsors
tools.description: Search licensed sponsors by name text, town, visa route and whether they have live jobs on Tarve. Returns the first page (20) with the total.

tools.name: going_rate
tools.description: The Home Office going rate, lower rate, general and lower thresholds, gov.uk skill level, Immigration Salary List and Temporary Shortage List status (with end dates) and whether a NEW Skilled Worker application can be made in a SOC 2020 code. Give a four-digit code, or search text to find codes by o

tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Live UK jobs from employers that hold a Skilled Worker sponsor licence, in SOC codes open to new applicants. Filter by text, city, SOC code and a minimum salary. Returns titles, employers, pay, codes and the job page URLs (the first 20 and the total); applying goes through the page.

tools.name: register_changes
tools.description: Organisations added to and removed from the Register of Licensed Sponsors between two dates (yyyy-MM-dd, at most 93 days apart): counts, the first 500 rows each, and the monthly CSV links on tarve.co.uk.

tools.name: site_stats
tools.description: How many live sponsored jobs and employers Tarve lists right now, how many are in codes open to new applicants, and when the register was last checked.
